skills.name: Reviewing .NET code
skills.description: Reviewing a C# change against the project's laws, naming file and line for every finding.
skills.whenToUse: When a C# change has to be reviewed.
skills.body:
## Instructions

1. List the changed files before reading any of them.
2. Read each diff hunk and check it against the Iron Laws in force.
3. Write one comment per finding, naming the file and the line.
4. End with a verdict: approve, or the list of things that block it.

## Verification

Every comment names a file and a line present in `git diff --name-only`. The verdict is one of the two forms above, never a hedge.

ironLaws.name: Never merge unreviewed
ironLaws.description: Nothing reaches the default branch without a human-readable review.
ironLaws.rule: Never merge a change nobody has read.
ironLaws.rationale: A merge is a claim that someone checked. Without a review the claim is unfounded and the next failure is unattributable.
examples: Read all four hunks, commented on two, approved with the verdict stated.
counterexamples: The change is small and green, so merged without reading it.
ironLaws.violationBehavior: Stop and read the change before saying anything about it.
